summary_en: Introduces VSAFDet, an underwater visual-sonar object-detection framework that uses adaptive cross-modal attention and feature reorganization to fuse highly heterogeneous, spatially misaligned camera and sonar observations. The paper also contributes UMOD, a synchronized visual-sonar benchmark with 4,000 paired samples spanning nine underwater categories, making it directly relevant to camera-sonar and acoustic-optical fusion research.
